汤姆与机场的计划(Tom and the the airport Plan): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:汤姆与凯特的经历和小计划。
The ticket office is one of the best places in the city. Kate's birthday is in November. Tom hopes to visit Toronto one day. You must be crazy to swim in December!
Last Friday, Tom and Kate went to the ticket office. The weather was rainy that day. Tom thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. In fact, the bus driver is friendly.
Tom bought a hat at the shop yesterday. Tom and Kate had great fun there. Both of them like chicken and milk. The committee judged the plan morally acceptable.
Tom spent the weekend at the cinema. It takes twenty minutes to get to the ticket office by bike. There are always many people at the airport.
